sentences.en: Livestock guard dogs, traditionally used to protect farm animals from predators, are now being used to protect the predators themselves
sentences.zh: 护畜犬过去被用来保护家畜，使其免遭捕食者袭击，如今人们也用它们来保护捕食者本身。

sentences.en: For thousands of years, livestock guard dogs worked alongside shepherds to protect their sheep, goats and cattle from predators such as wolves and bears.
sentences.zh: 数千年来，护畜犬一直与牧人并肩工作，保护他们的绵羊、山羊和牛免遭狼、熊等捕食者袭击。

sentences.en: But in the 19th and 20th centuries, when such predators were largely exterminated, most guard dogs lost their jobs.
sentences.zh: 但在19和20世纪，这类捕食者大多被消灭，绝大多数护畜犬也随之失去了差事。

sentences.en: In recent years, however, as increased efforts have been made to protect wild animals, predators have become more widespread again.
sentences.zh: 然而，近些年来，随着保护野生动物的力度加大，捕食者的分布范围又扩大了。

sentences.en: As a result, farmers once more need to protect their livestock, and guard dogs are enjoying an unexpected revival.
sentences.zh: 因此，农牧民又需要保护自己的家畜，护畜犬也出人意料地重新受到重用。

sentences.en: Today there are around 50 breeds of guard dogs on duty in various parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 如今，在世界各地承担护畜任务的狗大约有50个品种。

sentences.en: These dogs are raised from an early age with the animals they will be watching and eventually these animals become the dog’s family.
sentences.zh: 这些狗从小就和将来要照看的动物一起长大，久而久之，这些动物就成了它们的家人。

sentences.en: The dogs will place themselves between the livestock and any threat, barking loudly.
sentences.zh: 这些狗会挡在畜群和任何可能的威胁之间，大声吠叫。

sentences.en: If necessary, they will chase away predators, but often their mere presence is sufficient.
sentences.zh: 必要时，它们会把捕食者赶走，但往往只要它们在场就够了。

sentences.en: ‘Their initial training is to make them understand that livestock is going to be their life,’ says Dan Macon, a shepherd with three guard dogs.
sentences.zh: 养着三只护畜犬的牧羊人丹·梅肯说：“最初的训练，是让它们明白，往后它们的生活将围绕家畜展开。”

sentences.en: ‘A fluffy white puppy is fun to be around, but too much human affection makes it a great dog for guarding the front porch, rather than a great livestock guard dog.’
sentences.zh: “毛茸茸的小白狗，和它待在一起很有趣，可要是人们给它太多宠爱，它就会成为看守前廊的好狗，却当不成优秀的护畜犬。”

sentences.en: The evidence indicates that guard dogs are highly effective.
sentences.zh: 证据表明，护畜犬非常有效。

sentences.en: For example, in Portugal, biologist Silvia Ribeiro has found that more than 90 per cent of the farmers participating in a programme to train and use guard dogs to protect their herds against attack from wolves rate the performance of the dogs as very good or excellent.
sentences.zh: 例如，在葡萄牙，生物学家西尔维娅·里贝罗发现，在一项训练、使用护畜犬以保护畜群免遭狼袭的项目中，超过90%的参与农牧民把这些狗的表现评为“很好”或“极好”。

sentences.en: In a study carried out in Australia by Linda van Bommel and Chris Johnson at the University of Tasmania, more than 65 per cent of herders reported that predation stopped completely after they got the dogs, and almost all the rest saw a decrease in attacks.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚大学的琳达·范博梅尔和克里斯·约翰逊在澳大利亚开展了一项研究。超过65%的牧民表示，用上护畜犬后，家畜遭捕食的情况完全停止了；其余牧民中，几乎所有人都看到袭击有所减少。

sentences.en: ‘If they are managed and used properly, livestock guard dogs are the most efficient control method that we have in terms of the amount of livestock that they save from predation,’ says van Bommel.
sentences.zh: 范博梅尔说：“只要管理和使用得当，以保住多少家畜免遭捕食来衡量，护畜犬是我们现有的防控手段中效率最高的。”

sentences.en: But today’s guard dogs also have a new role – to help preserve the predators.
sentences.zh: 不过，今天的护畜犬还有一项新职责：帮助保护捕食者。

sentences.en: It is hoped that reductions in livestock losses can make farmers more tolerant of predators and less likely to kill them.
sentences.zh: 人们希望，随着家畜损失减少，农牧民会对捕食者更宽容，也更少去捕杀它们。

sentences.en: In Namibia, more than 90 per cent of cheetahs live outside protected areas, close to humans raising livestock.
sentences.zh: 在纳米比亚，超过90%的猎豹生活在保护区以外，靠近饲养家畜的人。

sentences.en: As a result, the cheetahs are often held responsible for animal losses, and large numbers have been killed by farmers.
sentences.zh: 因此，家畜受损时，猎豹往往被认定为祸首，许多猎豹遭到农牧民捕杀。

sentences.en: When guard dogs were introduced, more than 90 per cent of farmers reported a dramatic reduction in livestock losses, and said that as a result they were less likely to kill predators.
sentences.zh: 引入护畜犬后，超过90%的农牧民表示，家畜损失大幅减少，并说因此自己也更少会去捕杀捕食者。

sentences.en: Julie Young, at Utah State University in the US, believes this result applies widely.
sentences.zh: 美国犹他州立大学的朱莉·扬认为，这一结果具有广泛适用性。

sentences.en: ‘There is common ground from the livestock perspective and from the conservation perspective,’ she says.
sentences.zh: 她说：“从畜牧业的角度和从自然保护的角度看，双方有共同立场。”

sentences.en: ‘If ranchers don’t have a dead cow, they will not make a call to apply for a permit to kill a wolf.’
sentences.zh: “如果牧场主的牛没死，就不会打电话申请捕杀狼的许可。”

sentences.en: Looking at all the published evidence, Bethany Smith at Nottingham Trent University in the UK found that up to 88 per cent of farmers said they no longer killed predators after using dogs – but warned that such self-reported results must be taken with a pinch of salt.
sentences.zh: 英国诺丁汉特伦特大学的贝瑟尼·史密斯查阅了全部已发表的证据，发现自称用狗护畜后便不再捕杀捕食者的农牧民比例高达88%；但她也提醒，对于这类由当事人自己报告的结果，应该持保留态度。

sentences.en: What’s more, it is possible that livestock guard dogs merely displace predators to unprotected neighbouring properties, where their fate isn’t recorded.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有一种可能：护畜犬只是把捕食者赶到了邻近、缺乏保护的地块，之后这些捕食者的命运如何，并没有记录。

sentences.en: ‘In some regions, we work with almost every farmer, but in others only one or two have dogs,’ says Ribeiro.
sentences.zh: 里贝罗说：“在有些地区，我们几乎与每一户农牧民都有合作，但在其他一些地方，只有一两户养狗。”

sentences.en: ‘If we are not working with everybody, we are transferring the wolf pressure to the neighbour’s herd and he can use poison and kill an entire pack of wolves.’
sentences.zh: “如果我们没有与所有农牧民合作，就是把狼群带来的压力转移到了邻居的畜群，邻居可能会用毒药杀死整群狼。”

sentences.en: Another concern is whether there may be unintended ecological effects of using guard dogs.
sentences.zh: 另一个令人担忧的问题是，使用护畜犬会不会产生意料之外的生态影响。

sentences.en: Studies suggest that reducing deaths of one type of predator may have a negative impact on other species.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，减少一种捕食者的死亡数，可能会对其他物种产生不利影响。

sentences.en: The extent of this problem isn’t known, but the consequences are clear in Namibia.
sentences.zh: 这个问题的影响范围尚不清楚，但在纳米比亚，其后果已经很明显。

sentences.en: Cheetahs aren’t the only species that cause sheep and goat losses there: other predators also attack livestock.
sentences.zh: 在那里，造成绵羊和山羊损失的不只有猎豹，其他捕食者也会袭击家畜。

sentences.en: In 2015, researchers reported that in spite of the impact farmers obtaining guard dogs had on cheetahs, the number of jackals killed by dogs and people actually increased.
sentences.zh: 2015年，研究人员报告说，虽然农牧民采用护畜犬对猎豹产生了影响，狗和人杀死的胡狼数量实际上却增加了。

sentences.en: Guard dogs have other ecological impacts too.
sentences.zh: 护畜犬还会产生其他生态影响。

sentences.en: They have been found to spread diseases to wild animals, including endangered Ethiopian wolves.
sentences.zh: 研究发现，它们会向野生动物传播疾病，受影响的包括濒危的埃塞俄比亚狼。

sentences.en: They may also compete with other carnivores for food.
sentences.zh: 它们还可能与其他食肉动物争夺食物。

sentences.en: And by creating a ‘landscape of fear’, their mere presence can influence the behaviour of prey animals.
sentences.zh: 它们还会营造出一种“恐惧景观”，因此仅仅是在场，就可能影响猎物的行为。

sentences.en: The evidence so far, however, indicates that these consequences aren’t always negative.
sentences.zh: 不过，到目前为止，证据显示这些后果并不总是负面的。

sentences.en: Guard dogs can deliver unexpected benefits by protecting vulnerable wildlife from predators.
sentences.zh: 护畜犬能够保护易受袭击的野生动物免遭捕食，带来意想不到的好处。

sentences.en: For example, their presence has been found to protect birds which build their nests on the ground in fields, where foxes would normally raid them.
sentences.zh: 例如，研究发现，护畜犬在场就能保护那些在田野地面筑巢的鸟，而狐狸通常会到那里袭巢。

sentences.en: Indeed, Australian researchers are now using dogs to enhance biodiversity and create refuges for species threatened by predation.
sentences.zh: 事实上，澳大利亚研究人员现在正利用护畜犬提高生物多样性，并为受捕食威胁的物种创造庇护所。

sentences.en: So if we can get this right, there may be a bright future for guard dogs in promoting harmonious coexistence between humans and wildlife.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们能把这件事做好，护畜犬在促进人与野生动物和谐共处方面，或许会大有前景。
